contentEn.title: Skol 945B First Line Beach South facing 2 bedrooms

contentEn.description:
free wifi

 Super 2-bedroom south-facing apartment on the 9th floor of Block B in the Skol Building, with privileged views over the Mediterranean, Gibraltar, and Africa from the wonderful furnished terrace for 4 people. Surrounded by all amenities the city has to offer, so the car is not necessary. The apartment is designed to make your stay as comfortable as possible.

 Block B has two elevators, and access to the apartment is via stairs; once inside, the whole apartment is on the same level, with no stairs. Accommodation comprises: spacious living room with flat-screen TV with four international channels, 4-person dining area with sea views, and access to the terrace; fully-equipped kitchen with refrigerator, microwave, hob, washing machine, and a serving hatch to the living room; master bedroom with double bed, wardrobe, and north-facing window, second bedroom with two single beds, wardrobe, and window overlooking the street; and bathroom with shower. The apartment is equipped with A/C throughout, and its own Wi-Fi connection.

 The Skol cares for the environment, sourcing its energy partially from solar panels.

 

 🌐 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely.

 ❄ Private A/C in the bedroom and the living room.

 🏊‍♀️ Among the Skol’s facilities are its three unheated outdoors community pools, open all year round. Sunbeds have a cost of €3 per day, and are occupied on a first-come-first-served basis.

 🔑 Main reception open 24/7 to accommodate late arrivals.

 ☕ Cafeteria open seasonally, with direct access to the promenade from the community gardens.

 🛌 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach/pool towel) per guest are included in the rental price.

 Come and enjoy your holiday with the leader in vacation rentals in Marbella!

 🚗 If you want a parking space, once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive information about the parking closest to the Skol Building, which you may reserve online through an external company (price and availability on their website).
